worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.summary: A single sonic crack tears the air instantly: a straight fracture connects to the target as if it had no travel time, removing a fixed 20 HP from whatever it sweeps (only a type immunity stops it) and shoving them back. The reverb form follows a moment later with a second boom.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.use.1: Finish or chip a high-defence target for a fixed 20
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.use.2: Reverb form: seal off a straight line
Whatever the target's defence and typing, a hit always removes %1$s HP; only a type immunity stops it.
The crack reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s block hit radius; it is the fastest and cheapest hit in the family.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.reverb.on: Reverb form: %1$s seconds after the first boom it fires a second along the same direction, removing another fixed 20 from whoever is still on the line.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.reverb.off: Single form: one boom and done, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown; the second boom's coverage costs a longer cooldown and a longer self-hold.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.growth.0: From level %1$s the crack reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.growth.1: From level %1$s the crack reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.preference.r: On: a second boom follows the first along the same direction a moment later, removing another fixed 20 from anyone still on the line; the cost is a longer self-hold and cooldown. Off (single form, default): one boom, quicker and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.sonicboom.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from further away.
On: prefer it to finish a low-health target (a fixed 20 that ignores defence). Off: treat it as ordinary filler.
